title: 4th Grade Math Quiz
description: Ten questions for 4th graders: equivalent fractions, comparing fractions, adding fractions and multi-digit multiplication, with explanations.

questions.question: Which fraction is equivalent to 1/2?
questions.explanation: Multiply top and bottom of 1/2 by 2 to get 2/4. Both name the same amount.

questions.question: What is 3/8 + 2/8?
questions.explanation: Same denominator: add only the numerators, 3 + 2 = 5, keeping 8 on the bottom: 5/8. Never add the denominators.

questions.question: Which is greater: 3/4 or 5/8?
questions.explanation: 3/4 = 6/8, and 6/8 is greater than 5/8, so 3/4 is greater.

questions.question: What is 2/3 of 12?
questions.explanation: Divide 12 into 3 equal parts (12 ÷ 3 = 4), then take 2 parts: 2 × 4 = 8.

questions.question: Which fraction is in simplest form?
questions.explanation: 5 and 7 share no common factor except 1, so 5/7 cannot be reduced. The others can: 4/6 = 2/3, 3/9 = 1/3, 2/8 = 1/4.

questions.question: What is 7/10 − 3/10?
questions.explanation: Subtract only the numerators: 7 − 3 = 4, keeping the denominator 10: 4/10 (which simplifies to 2/5).

questions.question: Which symbol makes this true: 2/5 ___ 3/5?
questions.explanation: Same denominator, so compare numerators: 2 < 3, therefore 2/5 < 3/5.
